description: WSO2 SAP Successfactors Compensation Information provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsEmployeeCentral/overview). The service allows to manage employee compensation data, salary information, and pay components.
key-features: Access employee salary and compensation data
Manage pay scales, grades, and compensation planning
Query one-time deductions and recurring pay components
